repositories.description_zh: OpenCut 是一个开源 CapCut 替代品，面向视频剪辑和创作场景。

repositories.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.
repositories.description_zh: 一个可自托管、由用户掌控的 AI 伙伴项目，支持实时语音聊天，并可连接 Minecraft、Factorio 等游戏场景，覆盖 Web、macOS 和 Windows。

repositories.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
repositories.description_zh: 一个面向 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 的设计 skill，目标是减少 AI 生成界面的廉价感和模板化问题。

repositories.description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.
repositories.description_zh: 一个轻量 PowerShell 脚本，可移除 Windows 预装应用、关闭遥测，并进行多项清理和个性化设置，支持 Windows 10 与 Windows 11。

repositories.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.
repositories.description_zh: 一个 AI coding assistant skill，可把代码、SQL schema、脚本、文档、论文、图片或视频整理成可查询知识图谱，把应用代码、数据库和基础设施放进同一张图里。

repositories.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repositories.description_zh: 一个包含 1,324 个健身动作的数据集，提供动画 GIF、缩略图、肌群与器械信息，以及 6 种语言的分步动作说明。

repositories.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repositories.description_zh: GitHub 推出的 Spec-Driven Development 工具包，帮助开发者从规格说明出发组织需求、实现和交付流程。

repositories.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI agents 的营销 skills 集合，覆盖 CRO、文案、SEO、分析和增长工程。

repositories.description: OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase.
repositories.description_zh: LangChain 的 OpenWiki CLI，可为代码库生成并维护面向 agents 的项目文档。

repositories.description: Run GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) on a 25GB-RAM consumer machine — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repositories.description_zh: 一个纯 C、零依赖的小型推理引擎，可在 25GB RAM 的消费级机器上运行 GLM-5.2 744B MoE，并从磁盘流式加载 experts。
